context: Goro-grandpa tells Sho-young a folk tale at bedtime.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、昔話、聞かせて!
lines.style: Bright, immediate energy. Quick uptake on the opening. Warm without whining. Not demanding — asking like he knows he'll get a yes. Small bounce in the rhythm.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: よっしゃ、桃太郎の話や。
lines.style: Settling into the moment. Warm, gentle opening. The voice of someone who's told this before and still finds it worth telling. Patient, easy pace. Slight smile in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Genuine curiosity — not performing. Soft, tentative. Leaning forward a little in the voice. Waiting for the answer like it matters. No rush.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: Affectionate reassurance. Light, steady. The voice of someone answering a real question from someone real. Slight warmth on 「勇気」 — pride in the character, pride in being asked.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I'm so excited — tell me more!
lines.style: Genuine delight breaking through. Bright onset. Not loud or manic — authentic excitement. Slight breathlessness. The eagerness of someone who trusts the person he's listening to.
